agent.note: Real session, 2026-10-19: these plan_cli commands and outputs were run by Claude Code in a sandbox copy of brain/data (the stills come from that same plan).

lines.text: Make me a 12-song Sunday slow-jams mix from my library, around 90 BPM.
I'll create a plan, add twelve analyzed slow jams near 90 BPM, and build it.
Bash(uv run python -m brain.plan_cli new "Sunday Slow Jams" --activate)
Bash(uv run python -m brain.plan_cli add --plan sunday-slow-jams … 12 tracks)
added 12: Simply Red, Patrice Rushen, Anita Baker, Toni Braxton, 112, JoJo, Donell Jones, Majid Jordan, Ginuwine, Sade, Joe
Bash(uv run python -m brain.plan_cli build --plan sunday-slow-jams --profile mix-to-listen)
[beat-phase] Holding Back The Years -> Sweetest Taboo: ride 347 -> 348 to match snare parity + bar count
12 tracks · 11 transitions · 38 events · dry-run ready (4.3 s)
Done. Open claw-dj › Arrange to review it, or press Start mix.

typing.text: Ja Rule & Lil' Mo duets, early-2000s R&B

segments.vo: Prefer clicking? Describe a set in plain English, and it picks from music you own.
One click plans every transition: tempo, key, phrasing, even the backbeat.
Then it performs, live in Mixxx. The AI plans, and a real-time engine plays every beat.
